newsitem.title: USA: ADVISORY - Market closings for US, Canada holidays.
newsitem.headline: ADVISORY - Market closings for US, Canada holidays.

text.p: Following are early closings recommended or adopted for Friday, November 8, and market closings for Monday, November 11, in the U.S. and Canada.
Normal trading hours for the New York Stock Exchange, American Stock Exchange and NASDAQ both Friday and Monday.
The PSA recommended that U.S. Treasury and related markets close early at 1400 EST/1900 GMT on Friday.
U.S. Treasury and related markets will be closed on Monday for the U.S. Veterans Day holiday. Normal trading resumes on Tuesday.
The Toronto Bond Traders Association recommended an early 1500 EST/2000 GMT close for bond trading on Friday to commemorate Canada's Remembrance Day holiday on Monday.
Bonds resume trading on Monday but many dealers said they would take the day off.
Canadian banks are closed on Monday for the holiday.
Normal trading hours for the NYMEX energy and electricity markets both Friday and Monday COMMODITIES MARKETS
Normal trading house for COMEX markets both Friday and Monday.
